title: A Postcards for the Inventory
author: Ivo Whitlock
blurb: Sable Coldharbour, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
